trigger_result.observation_order: after collateral defaults, recoveries and prepayments; after note loss allocation; before cash distributions

review_limitations: One supplied opening snapshot and one future period; no observed-actual cash-flow assertion or calibrated default probability.
The exact simplified terms are supplied-reviewed, not independently interpreted or legally authenticated; no universal CLO/RMBS/CMBS waterfall support.
Default fractions apply first to opening par; scheduled principal then prepayments reduce surviving par; same-period recoveries are cash only, never reinstated collateral.
Interest collections, fixed fees and year fraction are supplied scenario inputs; no floating-rate reset, day-count derivation, reinvestment, lagged recovery, PIK or prior arrears.
Reserve supports fees then interest and is excluded from principal loss absorption and trigger collateral; excess principal is residual cash.
Eligibility is a supplied assertion; ineligible assets remain in totals and require adjudication. No price, agency rating, regulatory capital, legal opinion or execution determination.

calculation_lineage.formula: default = opening par * period default fraction; recovery = default * same-period recovery fraction; loss = default - recovery
prepay = (opening par - defaults - scheduled principal) * prepay fraction; principal cash = scheduled + prepay + recovery
loss absorbs opening collateral less notes first, then notes in descending seniority number; principal cash pays ascending seniority number
coupon due = opening note principal * fixed annual coupon * supplied year fraction; interest and reserve pay fees then note interest

trigger observed before cash distributions; reconstruct numerator and post-loss denominator with Fraction(str(original numeric value)); compare exact numerator < declared threshold * exact denominator; displayed ratio does not decide breach
breached trigger diverts remaining interest to sequential note principal, counted once in cash conservation
